mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Verona Area High School under a bright Full Moon.

The city has announced that a stretch of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final road work. Also, please remember that the city does not accept permit payments online, so verify any suspicious emails you receive.
There is plenty to enjoy this weekend, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

Regarding local activity, on September 5, the police department responded to reports of vehicles covered in cheese slices, which they identified as part of a viral social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
Today's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle, and the store is ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
